goal: Implement the pure function `evaluateRhythmHit(nowMs, targetMs, focus)` that returns one of {critical, perfect, good, off, miss} per the windows in docs/04-COMBAT_SYSTEM.md section 3.3, applying the focus widening rule and returning damage/RES modifiers.
constraints: Pure function. No imports beyond local types.
Signature: `evaluateRhythmHit(nowMs: number, targetMs: number, focus: number): RhythmResult`.
RhythmResult = { quality: RhythmQuality, damageMul: number, resReturn: number, deltaMs: number }.
Windows (delta = |nowMs - targetMs|): critical ≤40ms, perfect ≤80ms, good ≤160ms, off ≤300ms, else miss.
Focus widening: each window's tolerance is multiplied by (1 + min(focus,100)/200), max +50%.
Damage and RES modifiers exactly as in the table.
Document the function with a JSDoc reference to docs/04-COMBAT_SYSTEM.md.
acceptance: Test covers every boundary (±1ms each), every quality level, focus=0 and focus=100 cases.
Test verifies focus=100 expands the critical window to ≤60ms.
verification: bash -c 'npm run lint --silent && npm run typecheck --silent && npm run test --silent -- src/game/combat/rhythm-window'
